Attacks on shipping continue: on 10 November UKMTO reported a tanker struck by a projectile off Lima, Oman, ADNOC said one of its vessels was damaged in an attack in UAE waters, and the IRGC said three tankers were burning in the Strait of Hormuz, one after hitting a mine. The IRGC has lifted its 2,000 km missile-range cap. The question for Thursday 12 November is whether the run of near-daily shipping incidents continues and whether the US carries out a confirmed strike on Iran.

stories.event: ČEZ, the majority state-owned Czech power group, publishes unaudited results for January–September 2026 at 07:00 on Thursday 12 November 2026, followed by a conference call. The results come days after the cabinet approved an energy-act amendment allowing price caps on generators, which KB called negative for ČEZ.

stories.event: The Chamber of Deputies holds an extraordinary sitting on Friday 13 November 2026 for the second reading of the government's 50% windfall tax on refinery margins; the budget committee resumes the bill on Wednesday 11 November. Since early November ANO leaders have floated extending it by amendment to banks and possibly insurers, energy firms, mobile operators, retail chains and arms makers, with Babiš seeking up to CZK 60bn. The coalition council of 9 November, which was to discuss a first proposal from Finance Minister Schillerová, did not take up sector taxes because she was at ECOFIN in Brussels, and Deník N reported on 10 November that the plan's fate is uncertain. SPD and Motoristé figures are split or opposed, and the opposition and the banking association warn against a rushed add-on. Thursday 12 November is the last day before the second reading for the coalition to publish an amendment or say it will wait.

stories.event: The Dutch Tweede Kamer is scheduled to hold its final votes on the Belastingplan 2027 tax package on Thursday 12 November 2026, after plenary debates on 4 and 10 November; amendments are due by 14:00 on Wednesday 11 November. The D66–CDA–VVD minority cabinet of Prime Minister Rob Jetten holds 66 of 150 seats and has no agreed majority: ChristenUnie, 50PLUS and the seven-member Groep Markuszower said they would back the plan (78 seats together with the coalition), while the JA21–BBB–SGP bloc and the left-wing Pro and Volt are still negotiating. On 10 November Gidi Markuszower sought to withdraw confidence in the cabinet but said he would judge the tax plan on its merits; NOS reported that some parties think the vote could be postponed. JA21, BBB and SGP have signalled support for the separate box 3 capital-gains tax bill, which starts by 2029 at the latest.

stories.event: On Monday 9 November 2026 France formally attributed the 11–12 October cyberattack on refrigeration controls at about 700 French supermarket sites to the Shahid Kaveh unit of Iran's Revolutionary Guards; the Paris prosecutor opened a judicial investigation and requested arrest warrants. On 10 November Paris summoned Iran's ambassador, Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said France 'rules nothing out' and will push for EU sanctions, and Iran's foreign ministry rejected the 'baseless and one-sided accusations' and threatened 'appropriate measures'. The EU said it was ready for a swift and united response; foreign ministers meet on 16 November. ENISA chief Juhan Lepassaar warned that home appliances could be next, after similar attacks hit supermarkets in at least 12 European countries. On Thursday 12 November Emmanuel Macron is expected at the European Political Community summit in Dublin, whose agenda includes 'securing and defending a democratic Europe'; he has not yet commented on the attack personally.

stories.event: The Czech Finance Ministry publishes daily maximum retail prices for petrol and diesel in its Cenový věstník each working day for the next day under government regulation 203/2026, in force 1–30 November. On Tuesday 10 November it set the diesel cap for Wednesday 11 November at CZK 46.40 a litre, down 30 haléř and the eighth fall in a row, the lowest since caps began on 1 October; petrol was capped at CZK 40.94. Caps follow three-day averages of wholesale offers and Platts quotes plus a CZK 2.50 margin and VAT, and Brent fell from about 98 dollars on 6 November to about 92 on 10 November. On Thursday 12 November the ministry sets the cap for Friday 13 November. No decision on extending the regulation beyond 30 November has been reported.

stories.event: The COP31 UN climate conference runs in Antalya, Türkiye, from 9 to 20 Nov 2026, with Türkiye hosting and Australia leading the negotiations. The World Leaders' Summit takes place on 11-12 Nov; only 77 leaders are on the provisional speaker list, the US is absent and of the G20 only the UK (Andy Burnham), Brazil (Lula) and China are represented at head-of-state or government level besides the hosts. Türkiye is launching the non-binding '35 by 35' Global Electrification Pledge (electricity at least 35% of global final energy demand by 2035), with a high-level dialogue on 11 Nov; no endorsement count has been published. On 10 Nov Brazil's COP30 presidency presented its voluntary roadmap for transitioning away from fossil fuels, welcomed by India, Nigeria and Germany. Day 2 (12 Nov) has national statements from 09:00 to 17:00 and a closing ceremony at 17:00 local time.
